notes.title: Rog & Roll Adventure Demo Release!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38875356/2ecdfd0ef272766dfb03a27cef038dcbc7e113ce.png[/img]

Just in time for this year’s [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] - the [b]Rog & Roll Adventure Demo[/b] has been released!

[b]DEMO FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete the first world of the game!
[*] Play in [b]Adventure Mode[/b], which includes story cutscenes, a tutorial, an item shop, and an overworld to explore…
[*] Or stick with [b]Vintage Mode[/b], and play through levels in a more classic streamlined experience!
[*] Complete the demo to unlock a [b]Level Select[/b] mode (plus [b]2 BONUS LEVELS![/b])[/list]
[h3]Try it now for free on PC or Mac![/h3]
If you encounter any bugs or issues (or just want to share your impressions), please pass them along by selecting the [b]Feedback[/b] option either from the main menu or from the Pause menu during gameplay.

Thanks so much for playing! If you enjoy the demo, please consider [b]wishlisting[/b] the game - and keep an eye out for the full version, which should be rolling your way [b]very soon![/b]
